i.norm: Verifies that retainAll reports a modification (returns true) when it removes the collection's only element. Retaining against an empty collection drops every existing element, so the indexed collection changes and retainAll returns true.
Build a unique-indexed collection backed by an empty list. Every element is keyed to the constant value 0 by the key transformer.
Add the single element that the retainAll call will later drop.
Retaining only the elements present in an empty collection removes everything, so the collection is modified.
